I created `docs/policies/version-scheme.md`. It has a one-paragraph statement that the project's current recorded decision is Semantic Versioning (major.minor.patch). The reason given is better dependency management, meaning meaningful version constraints and compatibility checks for downstream consumers.

The project's memory records two version-scheme decisions, made minutes apart on Sep 25. The first adopted Calendar Versioning and the second reverted to Semantic Versioning. I treated the second as current. As you asked, I left the retired scheme out of the file.

Nothing in the repo records a version-scheme decision. A search for version-scheme terms found no matches, and `docs/doc.md` is only the Gin quick-start guide. I haven't committed anything.
